decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 13 June 2002 the erection of a single storey rear extension to the existing dwelling house with a maximum height of 3.5 metres, length of 4.5 metres and width of 2.4 metres would have been lawful within the meaning of sections 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) for the following reasons;

The proposed development would fall within Class A Part 1 Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning General Permitted Development Order 1995 because the cubic content of the resulting building would not exceed the cubic content of the original dwelling house by more than 70 cubic metres.

INFORMATIVE
Planning permission is not required
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a single storey side and rear extension with rooflights and removal of door from front to the side of the dwellinghouse.
